_comment_accounting_dues: Dues and assessments for the accounting add-on (D-035). Merged into the site's configuration only while ngdpbase.addons.accounting-dues.enabled is true. It needs the accounting add-on, whose managers it calls, and a manager that holds the accounts it bills.
_comment_label: What the site calls the charge on the module's screens and emails. A condominium says Assessment; money lines show the chart category's own name (docs/guides/chart-of-accounts-guide.md).
_comment_accounts_manager: The manager that holds the accounts billed: list(), get(id), assessment(id), owners(ctx, id) and lateCharges(). A condominium uses the condo add-on's CondoUnitManager (ngdpbase-addons).
_comment_categories: Chart codes a payment may be recorded under; the first is the one invoices charge. A list, so a site's value replaces this one.
_comment_organization: Who the invoices are from: the organization's name and postal address, and where to send payment.
_comment_database: The dues add-on's own database (D-035): invoices, kept outside the ledger, which holds only money that moved. Never the accounting add-on's database. encrypt 'optional': SQLCipher when NGDPBASE_DATABASE_KEY is set.

invoice-issue.description: Issue, void and email invoices for dues or assessments

ngdpbase.access.policies.name: Treasurer bills dues and assessments
ngdpbase.access.policies.description: The treasurer role issues and voids invoices. Recording payments is the accounting add-on's ledger-record.
